forum.title: FATFS UTF-8 support
forum.best_answer_content:
You're using older version of fatfs that does not support UTF8 yet.

![PavelA_0-1779039695395.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/2b7a85c1-d616-c51b-118f-d015857bb0f9.png "PavelA_0-1779039695395.png")

Old version of fatfs has #ifndef \_FATFS in ff.h, while the modern version (80386) has #ifndef FF\_DEFINED .

This is how you can distinguish them.

Whether or when ST is going to update fatfs in the Cube firmware packages is a different question.
forum.content_text:
I am using STM32CubeMX 6.16.1 to configure a project for STM32F415.

I use the FATFS on SD card and set it up as:

![MZadn2_3-1778741085479.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/7fc96697-d530-e14e-960e-982fa9aa4901.png "MZadn2_3-1778741085479.png")

According to FATFS documentation (<https://elm-chan.org/fsw/ff/doc/config.html#lfn_unicode>), the data type TCHAR should translate to char in this case. However, CubeMX generates Middlewares/Third\_Party/FatFs/src/ff.h in which TCHAR is defined as WCHAR, i.e. a 16-bit type:

![MZadn2_1-1778740933914.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/8e4dd514-9644-116f-7c60-07ba18e2a4af.png "MZadn2_1-1778740933914.png")

The \_STRF\_ENCODE is correctly defined as 3 in FATFS/Target/ffconf.h, which corresponds to UTF-8:

![MZadn2_2-1778740998616.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/1d0684bb-2c2c-3fd4-3111-9f2db2a70fe2.png "MZadn2_2-1778740998616.png")

Is this a bug? How can I ensure that UTF-8 uses the 8-bit data type correctly?
forum.author: MZadn.2

scraped_replies.html:
You're using older version of fatfs that does not support UTF8 yet.

Old version of fatfs has #ifndef _FATFS in ff.h, while the modern version (80386) has #ifndef FF_DEFINED .

This is how you can distinguish them.

Whether or when ST is going to update fatfs in the Cube firmware packages is a different question.
